text: Simple, useful, and aesthetically pleasing. I've been searching for the right app for me and came across this gem 💎😍 It has fun icons to cute themes. Dedicated mostly to track habits along with a task list. It has this motivating system where you earn sun points to achieve a goal on your wish list as you complete your habit and card quotes for the day. It's easy to maneuver with reports and reminders. It has all the things you need for a basic tracker.. You can also restore and backup data.
author: Cooky Knite

Hi! Thank you so much for your love and for taking the time to leave such a thoughtful review. We’re truly happy that ShineDay is helping you.
We’ve recently released several updates as well, and we’d love for you to update and continue enjoying the app. Your support means a lot to us!

text: Bought the lifetime premium version years ago, emailed them to get my premium back and never received a response.
author: Diana
developer_reply:
Hi! Sorry for the trouble. A previous bug caused automatic refunds, but it’s now fixed. Please update to the latest version on Google Play and try again.

To check your refund status:
Open Google Play → Tap your profile icon.
Payments & subscriptions → Budget & history.
If it says “Refunded” next to ShineDay, the process is complete.

text: I have tried many habit tracker apps, and this is a new favorite! I don't usually sign up for premium membership right away, but in this case, I did. The icons are so cute, and there are so many of them. You can customize the look in many ways. I love using this! It's a pleasure!
author: Cristina Escobar

text: ShineDay is an amazing habit tracker. It would be even more amazing if we had widgets 😁

developer_reply: Hi! So glad you’re enjoying ShineDay! We've actually added widgets in the latest version—please update the app and give them a try! 🥳

text: Love the way the app looks, but otherwise feels clunky to use. Some of the habits to choose from are repeated, and we should be able to input our own, with our own notes. Clicking a habit to see what it does and having no cancel button had me confused on what to click if I hadn't done it yet. Pending? Overall the use of the app could be improved immensely, and while I can see the established brand for your product and the aesthetic drew me in, I just don't feel inclined to use it :/
author: Cecil
developer_reply: Thanks for the honest feedback! We’ve actually made a lot of improvements recently to fix those clunky parts and smooth out the experience. Please update to the latest version—we’d love for you to give it another try and see the difference!
